integrity: The proof is algebraic and applies uniformly to all finite dimensions and real parameter values within the assumptions. The supplied numerical cross-checks are reproducibility aids rather than proofs; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-level real symmetric positive-definite spectra only; equal-dimensional approximate low-eigenspace; scalar inverse-projector boost constrained to gamma >= 1. No assertion about multilevel Galerkin operators, arbitrary spectra, iteration cost, or finite-step CG error.
title: Principal-angle phase transition for subspace-boosted two-level systems
